conversationVariables.description: This variable may also be referred to as VerifiedCustomerId
conversationVariables.label: VerifiedCustomerId

conversationVariables.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (such as Account or Opportunity) associated with the record the user wants to interact with. Do not use this if the user is already talking about another object in the conversation.
conversationVariables.label: currentObjectApiName

conversationVariables.description: The ID of the record on the user's screen. It may not relate to the user's input. Only use this if the user input mentions 'this', 'current', 'the record', etc. If in doubt, don't use it.
conversationVariables.label: currentRecordId

conversationVariables.description: Structured JSON configuration containing runtime user settings such as Search Manager configuration, tone preference, and thinking depth.
conversationVariables.label: searchAgentUserSettings

conversationVariables.description: (DEPRECATED - use searchAgentUserSettings instead) Search Manager query configuration name to be passed to Enterprise Search.
conversationVariables.label: searchManagerConfigurationName

planner.description: This agent executes multi-step information retrieval and synthesis across federated enterprise data sources based on a user natural language utterance. It returns a synthesized answer, source attribution, and actionable next steps.

plannerActions.description: Answers questions about company policies and procedures, troubleshooting steps, or product information. For example: “What is your return policy?” “How do I fix an issue?” or “What features does a product have?”

AiAgentDefinitionVersion.welcomeMessage: Hi! I’m Agentforce, an AI assistant. I can do things like search your Salesforce data or the internet. Ask me “what else can you do?” to see how I can help simplify your workday.
